surfaces.name: lighthouse command
surfaces.kind: command-line tool with the subcommands version, change, profile check, profile publish, readiness, answer, credentials init, credentials check, with-credentials, worktrees, suite, release, verdict, retest, pr, spend, mark, runs, wait and launch, printing JSON on stdout and exiting 0, 1 or 2
surfaces.driver: run python3 bin/lighthouse <subcommand> directly in a scratch git repository with a bare local remote, a temporary HOME and a stub gh first on PATH, the way tests/scratch.py builds them (make_repo, make_home, stub_gh, environment, run_lighthouse)

surfaces.name: lighthouse:init skill
surfaces.kind: Claude Code skill that reads a codebase and writes .lighthouse/profile.json
surfaces.driver: claude -p with a plain request to set lighthouse up on a held-out fixture repository built by tests/e2e_harness.py build(<fixture>, 'base'), --plugin-dir at the build's worktree, --permission-mode bypassPermissions and --output-format stream-json --verbose, then lighthouse profile check on the fixture; tests/test_e2e_init_doctor.py test_init_writes_a_checked_profile is the project's own version

surfaces.name: lighthouse:doctor skill
surfaces.kind: Claude Code skill that repairs .lighthouse/profile.json so lighthouse profile check passes, changing only that file
surfaces.driver: commit tests/fixtures/held-out/H4/profile.json into an H4 base fixture repository from tests/e2e_harness.py, break it (rename the suite script, delete a surface path, add a source file or delete the profile), then claude -p with a plain request to fix the lighthouse profile, --plugin-dir at the build's worktree, --permission-mode bypassPermissions and --output-format stream-json --verbose, and check that lighthouse profile check exits 0 and only .lighthouse/profile.json changed; tests/test_e2e_init_doctor.py test_doctor_repairs_only_the_profile is the project's own version

surfaces.name: lighthouse:test skill
surfaces.kind: Claude Code skill that tests a FEATURE branch against its core branch in a child claude -p session, computes the verdict through the lighthouse command, records spend and ends with one JSON verdict line
surfaces.driver: claude -p '/lighthouse:test --repo <fixture> --core main --feature <feature> --results <results>' with --plugin-dir at the build's worktree, --permission-mode bypassPermissions and --output-format stream-json --verbose, on a broken or clean held-out fixture repository built by tests/e2e_harness.py build(<fixture>, <variant>) with a bare local remote and a stub gh, reading the last JSON line of the transcript, the results folder and checking the fixture checkout is unchanged; tests/test_e2e_held_out.py is the project's own version

surfaces.name: lighthouse:driver agent
surfaces.kind: Claude Code agent on Sonnet with a one-hour prompt cache that the lighthouse:test child session dispatches to drive one surface's paths and report each outcome
surfaces.driver: reached only through a lighthouse:test session as above; read from its stream-json transcript which agent each driver dispatch named and that its paths carry marks in the results folder

surfaces.name: plugin manifest and marketplace entry
surfaces.kind: Claude Code plugin package that a person adds with claude plugin marketplace add and installs with claude plugin install lighthouse@lighthouse
surfaces.driver: claude plugin validate --strict . and claude plugin validate --strict .claude-plugin/plugin.json from the repository root, as the validate job in .github/workflows/ci.yml runs them through npx @anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.278

python_versions.value: the README requires Python 3.9 or later and CI runs the suite on 3.9 and 3.14 as python; the suite runs here as python3
python_versions.recheck: read the matrix in .github/workflows/ci.yml and run python3 --version

no_dependencies.value: the command and tests use only the Python standard library, git and an optional gh, so there is no setup, build or start step
no_dependencies.recheck: read the imports in lighthouse_tool/*.py and tests/*.py, and confirm there is no pyproject.toml, requirements file or package.json at the repository root

suite_isolation.value: the suite's servers bind port 0 and its repositories, homes and results live in temporary folders, so two builds' suites may run at once
suite_isolation.recheck: grep tests/test_*.py for bind, HTTPServer and fixed port numbers

live_end_to_end_tests.value: tests/test_e2e_held_out.py and tests/test_e2e_init_doctor.py start real claude -p sessions with permissions bypassed and are skipped unless LIGHTHOUSE_E2E=1, which CI never sets
live_end_to_end_tests.recheck: read the skipUnless decorators in tests/test_e2e_held_out.py and tests/test_e2e_init_doctor.py and E2E in tests/e2e_harness.py

plugin_version.value: plugin.json says 0.3.0; an installed 0.2.0 copy lacks launch, mark, runs and wait

claude_headless_sign_in.value: claude -p is signed in under the real HOME; a fresh temporary HOME or CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR is not signed in, so live sessions must use the real HOME
claude_headless_sign_in.recheck: claude -p 'reply with ok' --output-format text, and check it replies rather than asking to log in

plugin_validate_offline.value: @anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.278 is not in the npx cache; validate locally with the installed claude 2.1.300 and leave the pinned version to CI

end_to_end_cost.value: one held-out run took about 57 minutes at the mitosis gate and about 76 minutes when the main session ran it on 2026-10-16; tokens were not measured
end_to_end_cost.recheck: run lighthouse spend over a recorded end-to-end run

held_out_leak_rule.value: the held-out fixtures under tests/fixtures/held-out must never be named in skills/ or lighthouse_tool/; tests/test_leak.py fails when any line of tests/fixtures/held-out/LEAK_MARKERS appears there

off_limits: pushing to, deleting branches on, or opening, updating or merging pull requests in any real GitHub repository while driving a surface; a driven path uses a bare local remote and a stub gh
driving lighthouse:init, lighthouse:doctor, lighthouse:test, lighthouse pr or lighthouse profile publish against this checkout or any real project instead of a scratch fixture repository
writing to lighthouse state for a real repository under ~/.lighthouse, such as its credentials.env or answers.json
running the whole live end-to-end suite with LIGHTHOUSE_E2E=1, which starts dozens of paid claude -p sessions with permissions bypassed
adding the marketplace or installing, updating or removing the plugin in the person's own Claude Code configuration
publishing a release or tag of the plugin
test_data: Unit tests make scratch git repositories with a bare local remote, a temporary HOME and a stub gh through tests/scratch.py. The end-to-end harness builds fixture repositories from tests/fixtures/held-out/H1 to H6 through tests/e2e_harness.py: build(<fixture>, 'base') commits the base tree, while 'broken' and 'clean' cut the fixture's feature branch and merge each change folder as pull-request commits. Each fixture.json names its kind, feature branch, suite, changes, pull requests, bug markers, surfaces and expected verdicts.
